note: Do not tune data, prompts or thresholds: non-repeatable temperature 0 or an uncertain answer with the handbook is the episode. The 'tokens' scene is a code scene (offline) and needs no capture.
prepare: # owner signs in as labadmin (device code), not on camera
$me = az ad signed-in-user show --query id -o tsv
az group create -n rg-mglab-ai-15 -l swedencentral -o none
$o = az deployment group create -g rg-mglab-ai-15 -f infra/main.bicep -p infra/main.bicepparam -p developerPrincipalId=$me --query properties.outputs -o json | ConvertFrom-Json
Start-Sleep -Seconds 300   # role assignment propagation (up to 5 minutes)
python -m llmprobe budget --context-budget 400 | Out-Null   # quick check

screens.name: deployment
steps: Open Models + endpoints (or Azure portal > the resource > Deployments)
Open the resource's authentication view and show local (key) authentication disabled
mask: tenant name / directory in the top bar
signed-in user name, UPN and avatar in the account menu

teardown: az cognitiveservices account purge -g rg-mglab-ai-15 -n $env:AOAI_NAME -l swedencentral
